5.1 Results of the experiment

5.1.1 Data importation

Notations :

  • Date_start : Start of the experiement (t0)
  • Molecule : Substance to which the earthworm is exposed
  • Dose : Exposure dose (mg/kg)
  • ID_recipient : Recipient in which the soil was prepared
  • ID_camp : ID of the earthworm campagne and generation (see XXX for more information)
  • ID : ID of the earthworm
  • Nb_rep : Identification number of the replicate
  • Time_point : Time point to which the earthworm is dedicated
  • Phase : Uptake or Elimination phase
  • Time_introduction_D0 : Time of the day when the earthworm was introduced into his contaminated cosm
  • w0 : Body weight at t0
  • w_Tp : Body weight at the given time point
  • w_frozen : Body weight before congelation
  • C_worm : Measured concentration of the substance in the earthworm
  • C_soil : Measured concentration of the substance in the soil at the given time point
Code 
Levels_time_points <- c("0,25b", "1", "1b", "2", "3", "3b", as.character(seq(4,42,1)))


df_TK_EPX <- f_read_data_TK("EPX") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, -1)))


df_TK_EPX <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(
    Time = t,
    CiIMD = C_worm_IMD,
    CiEPX = C_worm_EPX,
    Weight = Weight_nog,
    Time_point_f = as.factor(Time_point)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(Time, CiEPX, CiIMD, Weight, w, Molecule, ID, expo, Time_point_f, Nb_rep, Experiment) |> 
  mutate(
    CiEPX = na_if(CiEPX, -1),
    CiIMD = na_if(CiIMD, -1)
    )|> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )

df_TK_EPX_mean <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  dplyr::select(-ID) |> 
  group_by(Time) |> 
  summarise(
    CiEPX = exp(mean(log(CiEPX[CiEPX > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    CiIMD = exp(mean(log(CiIMD[CiIMD > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    Weight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    w = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
    expo = mean(expo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Molecule = "EPX")

5.1.3 Growth curves

Growth data obtained during the TK and TK BIS experiment are shown Figure 5.2.

Time points with a “b” corresponds to the experiment TK BIS where earthworms were massaged instead of fasting for a day.

Code 
col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[2], Nord_aurora[3], Nord_aurora[4])
ID_tri <- c(1, 9, 17, 25, 33, 41, 49, 57, 65, 73, 81, 89, 97, 107, 115, 123, 131, 134, 137)

df_TK_EPX_plot <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  filter(!is.na(Weight))

y_segment <- 1.5

df_phases <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  filter(ID %in% ID_tri)|>
  arrange(Time_point_f, Time) |>
  group_by(Time_point_f) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(Time_point_f, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point = as.numeric(as.character(Time_point_f)),
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & Time_point <= 21) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & Time_point <= 21) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & Time_point > 21) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & Time_point > 21) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & Time_point > 21) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )


p_EPX <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_segment(
    data = df_phases,
    aes(
      x = t_start,
      xend = t_end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      color = factor(Phase)
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    data = df_TK_EPX_plot,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = w,
      group = ID
      ),
    alpha=1,
    color = col_EPX,
    linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_TK_EPX,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = w,
      group = ID
      ),
    alpha=0.5,
    color = col_EPX
    ) +

  facet_wrap(~Time_point_f)+
  labs(
    title = "Growth Curves",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Weight",
    color = ""
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure,
    label = c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Depuration"),
    name = "Phase"
    )+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  # Thème minimaliste
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(
      color="black", 
      fill=Nord_snow[3], 
      size=0, 
      linetype="solid"
      ),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

5.1.4 Measured internal concentrations

Measured internal concentrations are presented Figure 5.3. A pronounced difference in measured internal concentrations between the TK and TK BIS experiments was observed at common sampling time points. This discrepancy suggests non-negligible elimination occurring during the depuration phase on Petri dishes in the TK design, leading to lower apparent internal concentrations compared to the TK BIS experiment. In contrast, this difference was less evident for imidacloprid, consistent with its slower toxicokinetic dynamics and reduced sensitivity to elimination during the depuration phase.

Code 
p <- ggplot(
  data = df_TK_EPX |> filter(Time!=0 & !is.na(CiEPX)),
  aes(
    x = Time
  )
  )+
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(
      y = CiEPX,
    color = Experiment,
    fill = Experiment
    )
  )+
  facet_wrap(~Molecule, ncol = 2, scales = "free")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col_EPX, Nord_aurora[4]))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col_EPX, Nord_aurora[4]))+
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Concentration in earthworm (ng/g)"
  )+
  #lims(x=c(0,5))+
  theme_minimal()

5.2 Modeling of the toxicokinetics

Names of models :

  • C1 : One compartment model.
  • C1P : One compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
  • C2 : Two-compartment model.
  • C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.

5.2.1 In files creation for MCMC

Code 
Molecule <- "EPX"

########## C1 ################################################################

path_mod_EPX_C1 <- here::here("mod/TK_EPX_C1")
path_fig_C1 <- here::here("fig/TK_single/EPX_C1/")

Nb_Iter <- 100000
seeds <- c(C1 = 3333, C2 = 6656, C3 = 111222)

text_priors <- "Distrib(kuEPX,     LogUniform,   0.00001, 10000); # min, max 
Distrib(keEPX,    LogUniform,   0.00001, 10000); # min, max

Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal,   0.005,   0.005,    -0.5,    1); # mean, sd, min, max
Distrib (Vr_a_growth,  TruncNormal, 0.0015, 0.01, 0, 1);

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);
Distrib(Sigma_CiEPX, TruncNormal,  3.0, 3.0,    1, 1000);"

text_likelihood <- "Likelihood(CiEPX,  LogNormal, Prediction(CiEPX),  Sigma_CiEPX);  # Calcul des vraisemblances (geometric mean, geometric standard deviation)
Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"

f_In_tot(path_mod_EPX_C1, Molecule, text_priors, text_likelihood, text_param_ind, Nb_Iter, seeds)

########## C1P ################################################################

path_mod_EPX_C1P <- here::here("mod/TK_EPX_C1P")
path_fig_C1P <- here::here("fig/TK_single/EPX_C1P/")

Nb_Iter <- 100000
seeds <- c(C1 = 333266, C2 = 660660, C3 = 110110) # Done on CEA servers (CCRT)

text_priors <- "Distrib(kuEPX,     LogUniform,   0.00001, 100000); # min, max 
Distrib(keEPX,    LogUniform,   0.00001, 100000); # min, max

Distrib(phi,     Uniform,   0.0, 1); # min, max

Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal,   0.005,   0.005,    -0.5,    1); # mean, sd, min, max
Distrib (Vr_a_growth,  TruncNormal, 0.0015, 0.01, 0, 1);

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);
Distrib(Sigma_CiEPX, TruncNormal,  3.0, 3.0,    1, 1000);"

text_likelihood <- "Likelihood(CiEPX,  LogNormal, Prediction(CiEPX),  Sigma_CiEPX);  # Calcul des vraisemblances (geometric mean, geometric standard deviation)
Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"

f_In_tot(path_mod_EPX_C1P, Molecule, text_priors, text_likelihood, text_param_ind, Nb_Iter, seeds)

# ./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_C1.in

An example of how to run the models MCMC is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

Code 
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_EPX
pwd

makemcsim m_TK_EPX.model &
for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_C${j}.in
done
  • Input files must a name like “xxxxx_C1.in”
  • Output files must a name like “xxxxx_C1.out”

Common parameters :

  • The number of chains used : 3
  • The number of experiments : 71
  • The number of last iterations used to describe the posterior distribution : 10^{4}
  • The number of last iterations used to create the tab_setpoint.out file : 333

C1 : Number of parameters = 6 C1P : Number of parameters = 7 C2 : Number of parameters = 7 C2P : Number of parameters = 8

col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

df_priors_dist_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuEPX", "keEPX","kcomp_in", "kcomp_out") & samples > 0.01))

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1, 
    aes(
       x = samples
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy" 
    ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Priors distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_priors

# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_C1 <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains, MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})

  par(mfrow=c(1,3))

  gelman.plot(mcmc_list_C1,
            bin.width = 10,      # Number of observations per segment,
            # first segment --> at least 50 iterations.
            max.bins = 50,       # Maximum number of bins, excluding the last one
            confidence = 0.95,   # Coverage probability of confidence interval.
            transform = FALSE,   # improve the normality of the distribution
            autoburnin=TRUE)     # Remove first half of sequence

  
  gelman <- gelman.diag(mcmc_list_C1, confidence = 0.95, transform=FALSE, autoburnin=TRUE, multivariate=TRUE)
  print(gelman)

f_get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

########## C1 #######################################################

MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$"))

ku_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "kuEPX")
ke_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "keEPX")

BCF_samples_C1 <- ku_samples_C1$value / ke_samples_C1$value

BCF_mode_C1 <- f_get_mode(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_CI_C1 <- quantile(BCF_samples_C1, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
BCF_CI_low_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[1])
BCF_CI_up_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[2])
BCF_min_C1 <- min(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_max_C1 <- max(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_mean_C1 <- mean(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_sd_C1 <- sd(BCF_samples_C1)

  BCF_mode_C1, 
  BCF_CI_low_C1, BCF_CI_up_C1,

Code 
Nb_experiment <- Nb_experiment_C1

######### Observed data ######################################################
dObs_ind <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(
    ID = as.numeric(ID),
    Group_tmp = case_when(
      ID < 65 ~ "Uptake",
      (ID > 64 & ID <= 128) ~ "Elimination",
      ID > 128 ~ "Uptake\n(with massage only)"),
    Group = fct_relevel(Group_tmp, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake\n(with massage only)"))
    )

colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiEPX"] <- "CiEPX_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"


############ C1 ##############################################################

Sim.Res.ind_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_EPX_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment_C1){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Time_pred = dObs_i$Time # !!!
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiEPX")
  
  Nsortie = 2
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight" & Time !=0)
df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiEPX" & Time !=0)

df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |> 
  left_join(df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred")) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(Weight_obs, CiIMD)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |> 
  left_join(df_mod_Weight_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred"))|>
  dplyr::select(-c(CiEPX_obs, CiIMD)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

############ C2 ##############################################################

Sim.Res.ind_C2 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_EPX_C2, paste0("Setpoints_ind_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C2 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment_C2){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind_C2, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Time_pred = dObs_i$Time # !!!
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiEPX")
  
  Nsortie = 2
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C2 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C2, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C2 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C2, Endpt == "CiEPX" & Time !=0)

  y_1 = seq_line/fact_1,

  labs(
    x = "Observed weight of earthworms (g)",
    y = "Predicted weight of earthworms (g)"
  )+
  theme_minimal()

dObs_ind <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID))
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiEPX"] <- "CiEPX_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

time_limits <- dObs_ind %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(time_cutoff = max(Time, na.rm = TRUE) + 5)

Time_points_Nb_rep <- dObs_ind |> 
  dplyr::select(ID, Time_point_f, Nb_rep)

y_segment <- 1000

df_phases <- dObs_ind |>
  arrange(ID, Time) |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(ID, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & ID < 65) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID < 65) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & ID > 64) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID > 64) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & ID > 64) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  )

An example of how to run the simulations for the individual trajectories is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

Code 
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_EPX
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 71); do
./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_Setpoint_ind_full_${j}.in
done
Code 
##| cache: false

#nb_rows_ind_C1 <- NC_C1*N_iter_setpoint_C1+1

########## C1 #############################################

Sim.Res.ind.full_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment_C1, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_EPX_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_full_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment_C1){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind.full_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind.full_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiEPX", "C_exposure")
  
  Nsortie = length(Nom_Endpoints)
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind.full_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind.full_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiEPX")
df_mod_CeEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "C_exposure")

  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind.full_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind.full_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1P <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1P, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_CeEPX_ind_C1P <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1P, Endpt == "C_exposure")

alpha_point <- 0.5
col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[2], Nord_aurora[3], Nord_aurora[4])

p_CiEPX_traj <- ggplot()+
  
  geom_segment(
    data = df_phases_plot,
    aes(
      x = t_start,
      xend = t_end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      group = ID,
      color = factor(Phase)
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_EPX
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= up,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_EPX
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= predict.endpoint,
      group = ID
      ),
    color = col_EPX,
    lwd=1
    )+
  geom_ribbon(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      ymax= up,
      ymin= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    fill = col_EPX,
    alpha=0.1
    )+
  geom_point(
    data = dObs_ind_plot,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = CiEPX_obs
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = col_red
  )+
  # facet_wrap(
  #   ~ID,
  #   ncol=4,
  #   #scales = "free_x"
  #   )+
  facet_grid(
    vars(Time_point_days), vars(No_rep)#,
    )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure,
    label = c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Depuration"),
    name = "Phase"
    )+
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "CiEPX (ng/g)"
  )+
  #lims(y=c(0, 300))+
  theme_minimal()

5.2.8 Simulation of the toxicodynamic in earthworms throughout the exposition

The goal here is to recreate the concentration dynamic in the average earthworm during our exposition scheme but without the fasting phase that was required for chemical analysis and during which elimination was happening.

############ C1 ###########################################
Sim.Res_C1 <- as.data.frame(fread(here::here(path_mod_EPX_C1, "Setpoints.out"),sep="\t"))
  
  Nom_Endpoints =c("Weight_1", "CiEPX_1", "C_exposure_1")
  Nsortie = 3
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL

  for (i in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste("^",Nom_Endpoints[i],"\\.", sep="") , colnames(Sim.Res_C1), fixed=FALSE )
    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res_C1[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[i], ncol(Data_sim)))

    }

  df_mod_C1 <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = c( rep(Time_pred, Nsortie)),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint,
    Experiment = c(rep(rep("Experience 1", length(Time_pred)), Nsortie))
    )
  
df_mod_Weight_C1 <- subset(df_mod_C1, Endpt == "Weight_1")

5.3 Summary

In the case of epoxiconazole, the one-compartment model (C1) showed poor predictive performance with a clear underestimation of the steady-state and a poorly captured elimination dynamic (Figure 7.25). The two-compartment model (C2) slightly improved the fit but the most probable model is the two-compartment model with an exposure through the gut route in Petri dishes (C2P) which demonstrated excellent predictive performance for internal concentrations in individual earthworms, with individual trajectories closely matching observed data points (Figure 5.45). All predictions fell within the 5-fold change region, with 91.5% within the 2-fold change region (Figure 7.28). This improvement of model predictions is reflected in a much lower BIC (?tbl-EPXressumall). It should be noted, however, that the model still tends to overestimate internal concentrations during the second elimination phase (Figure 7.32). The estimated toxicokinetic parameters of all tested models are summarized in ?tbl-EPXressumall.

Code 
format_summary <- function(summary_df, model_name) {
  
  summary_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(BCF = last_col()) |> 
    rownames_to_column("stat") %>%
    filter(stat %in% c("Result_mode", "2.5%", "97.5%")) %>%
    
    pivot_longer(-stat, names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
    
    mutate(
      value = sprintf("%.3g [%.3g ; %.3g]", Result_mode, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(model, param, value)
}

res_C1   <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C1, "C1")
res_C1P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C1P, "C1P")
res_C2   <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C2, "C2")
res_C2P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C2P, "C2P")

all_res <- bind_rows(res_C1, res_C1P, 
                     res_C2, res_C2P)


round_fold <- 1

extra_metrics <- tibble(
  model = c("C1","C1P","C2","C2P"),
  LL   = c(round(LL_C1, round_fold), round(LL_C1P, round_fold), round(LL_C2, round_fold), round(LL_C2P, round_fold)),
  BIC  = c(round(BIC_C1, round_fold), round(BIC_C1P, round_fold), round(BIC_C2, round_fold), round(BIC_C2P, round_fold)),
  fold2 = c(round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C1, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C1P, round_fold),  
            round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C2, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C2P, round_fold)),
  fold5 = c(round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C1, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C1P, round_fold), 
            round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C2, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C2P, round_fold))
)

final_table <- all_res %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = value) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("\\.1\\.$", "", .)) |> 
  relocate(BCF, .after = last_col()) |> 
  left_join(extra_metrics, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::select(model, everything())

final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = model
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -model
  ) %>%

Model simulations of concentration dynamics in the average earthworm under the exposure scenario of the first toxicokinetic experiment (TK) (excluding the fasting phase used for chemical analysis during which elimination occurred) revealed distinct kinetic behaviors between the two pesticides (Figure 3). Epoxiconazole exhibited rapid uptake and elimination kinetics, while imidacloprid showed considerably slower uptake and elimination processes. Correspondingly, the bioaccumulation factor (BAF) was substantially higher for imidacloprid (21 gsoil·gworm, wwt-1) compared to epoxiconazole (0.87 gsoil·gworm, wwt-1), reflecting its greater tendency to accumulate in earthworm tissues and slower clearance from the organism.

# Toxicokinetics of Epoxiconazole {#sec-ModEPX}

## Results of the experiment

### Data importation

Notations :

-   `Date_start` : Start of the experiement (t0)
-   `Molecule` : Substance to which the earthworm is exposed
-   `Dose` : Exposure dose (mg/kg)
-   `ID_recipient` : Recipient in which the soil was prepared
-   `ID_camp` : ID of the earthworm campagne and generation (see XXX for more information)
-   `ID` : ID of the earthworm
-   `Nb_rep` : Identification number of the replicate
-   `Time_point` : Time point to which the earthworm is dedicated
-   `Phase` : Uptake or Elimination phase
-   `Time_introduction_D0` : Time of the day when the earthworm was introduced into his contaminated cosm
-   `w0` : Body weight at t0
-   `w_Tp` : Body weight at the given time point
-   `w_frozen` : Body weight before congelation
-   `C_worm` : Measured concentration of the substance in the earthworm
-   `C_soil` : Measured concentration of the substance in the soil at the given time point

```{r data, warning=F, message=F}

Levels_time_points <- c("0,25b", "1", "1b", "2", "3", "3b", as.character(seq(4,42,1)))


df_TK_EPX <- f_read_data_TK("EPX") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, -1)))


df_TK_EPX <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(
    Time = t,
    CiIMD = C_worm_IMD,
    CiEPX = C_worm_EPX,
    Weight = Weight_nog,
    Time_point_f = as.factor(Time_point)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(Time, CiEPX, CiIMD, Weight, w, Molecule, ID, expo, Time_point_f, Nb_rep, Experiment) |> 
  mutate(
    CiEPX = na_if(CiEPX, -1),
    CiIMD = na_if(CiIMD, -1)
    )|> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )

df_TK_EPX_mean <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  dplyr::select(-ID) |> 
  group_by(Time) |> 
  summarise(
    CiEPX = exp(mean(log(CiEPX[CiEPX > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    CiIMD = exp(mean(log(CiIMD[CiIMD > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    Weight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    w = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
    expo = mean(expo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Molecule = "EPX")
```

### Growth curves

Growth data obtained during the TK and TK BIS experiment are shown @fig-growthdata.

Time points with a "b" corresponds to the experiment TK BIS where earthworms were massaged instead of fasting for a day.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
#| fig-cap: Evolution of earthworms body weight through the experiment. Time points with a "b" corresponds to data points from the TK BIS experiment.
#| label: fig-growthdata
#| fig-width: 8

col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[2], Nord_aurora[3], Nord_aurora[4])
ID_tri <- c(1, 9, 17, 25, 33, 41, 49, 57, 65, 73, 81, 89, 97, 107, 115, 123, 131, 134, 137)

df_TK_EPX_plot <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  filter(!is.na(Weight))

y_segment <- 1.5

df_phases <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  filter(ID %in% ID_tri)|>
  arrange(Time_point_f, Time) |>
  group_by(Time_point_f) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(Time_point_f, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point = as.numeric(as.character(Time_point_f)),
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & Time_point <= 21) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & Time_point <= 21) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & Time_point > 21) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & Time_point > 21) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & Time_point > 21) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )
```

### Measured internal concentrations

Measured internal concentrations are presented @fig-CiData. A pronounced difference in measured internal concentrations between the TK and TK BIS experiments was observed at common sampling time points. This discrepancy suggests non-negligible elimination occurring during the depuration phase on Petri dishes in the TK design, leading to lower apparent internal concentrations compared to the TK BIS experiment. In contrast, this difference was less evident for imidacloprid, consistent with its slower toxicokinetic dynamics and reduced sensitivity to elimination during the depuration phase.

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Measurements of EPX concentration in earthworms exposed to 10 mg/kg of EPX and related weight measurement of earthworms. Points represent the experimental data, the blue curve and the transparent blue band are produced with geom_smooth.

#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

  data = df_TK_EPX |> filter(Time!=0 & !is.na(CiEPX)),
  aes(
    x = Time
  )
  )+
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(

    color = Experiment,

    )

  facet_wrap(~Molecule, ncol = 2, scales = "free")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col_EPX, Nord_aurora[4]))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col_EPX, Nord_aurora[4]))+
  labs(
```

## Modeling of the toxicokinetics

Names of models :

-   C1 : One compartment model.
-   C1P : One compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
-   C2 : Two-compartment model.
-   C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.

### In files creation for MCMC

```{r increation, message=F, warning=F}
#| code-show: show

Molecule <- "EPX"

########## C1 ################################################################

path_mod_EPX_C1 <- here::here("mod/TK_EPX_C1")
path_fig_C1 <- here::here("fig/TK_single/EPX_C1/")

Nb_Iter <- 100000
seeds <- c(C1 = 3333, C2 = 6656, C3 = 111222)

text_priors <- "Distrib(kuEPX,     LogUniform,   0.00001, 10000); # min, max 
Distrib(keEPX,    LogUniform,   0.00001, 10000); # min, max

Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal,   0.005,   0.005,    -0.5,    1); # mean, sd, min, max
Distrib (Vr_a_growth,  TruncNormal, 0.0015, 0.01, 0, 1);

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);
Distrib(Sigma_CiEPX, TruncNormal,  3.0, 3.0,    1, 1000);"

text_likelihood <- "Likelihood(CiEPX,  LogNormal, Prediction(CiEPX),  Sigma_CiEPX);  # Calcul des vraisemblances (geometric mean, geometric standard deviation)
Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"

f_In_tot(path_mod_EPX_C1, Molecule, text_priors, text_likelihood, text_param_ind, Nb_Iter, seeds)

########## C1P ################################################################

path_fig_C1P <- here::here("fig/TK_single/EPX_C1P/")

Distrib(keEPX,    LogUniform,   0.00001, 100000); # min, max

Distrib(phi,     Uniform,   0.0, 1); # min, max

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);

Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"

f_In_tot(path_mod_EPX_C1P, Molecule, text_priors, text_likelihood, text_param_ind, Nb_Iter, seeds)

########## C2 ################################################################

```

An example of how to run the models MCMC is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, eval=F, execute=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_EPX
pwd

makemcsim m_TK_EPX.model &
for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_C${j}.in
done
```

-   Input files must a name like "xxxxx_C1.in"
-   Output files must a name like "xxxxx_C1.out"

Common parameters :

-   The number of chains used : `r NC_C1`
-   The number of experiments : `r Nb_experiment_C1`
-   The number of last iterations used to describe the posterior distribution : `r Nb_iter_kept_C1`
-   The number of last iterations used to create the `tab_setpoint.out` file : `r N_iter_setpoint_C1`

C1 : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C1` C1P : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C1P` C2 : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C2` C2P : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C2P`

```{r EPXpriorsC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors.
#| label: fig-EPXpriorC1
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

n_samples <- 1e6 # Simulation of the distribution
col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

df_priors_dist_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuEPX", "keEPX","kcomp_in", "kcomp_out") & samples > 0.01))

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1, 
    aes(
       x = samples

    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,

    normalize = "xy"

    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r EPXreadpriorsC1P, message = F, warning = F}

  options = list(

      )

#MCMC_out_EPX$Priors
```

```{r EPXpriorsC1P, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors.
#| label: fig-EPXpriorC1P
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

n_samples <- 1e6 # Simulation of the distribution
col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

df_priors_dist_C1P <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1P$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuEPX", "keEPX","kcomp_in", "kcomp_out") & samples > 0.01))

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1P, 
    aes(
       x = samples
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy" 
    ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Priors distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_priors 

```

```{r EPXChainsC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Parameters chains. Only the first iteration and the last `r Nb_iter_kept` are represented.
#| label: fig-EPXchainsC1
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8

p_chains <-  
  ggplot(
    data = MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> filter(Iteration > 1), 
    aes(
      x = Iteration, 
      y = value, 
      color = as.factor(Chain), 
      group = as.factor(Chain)
      )
  )+
  geom_line(alpha=0.7)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 2)+
  
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", values = nord(palette = "frost"))+
  
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    title=element_text(size=12, face="plain"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(face="plain"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="white")
    )

p_chains
```

We can also take a look at the likelihood and the deviance ratio.

::: panel-tabset
## C1

```{r EPXlikeC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Evolution of likelihood and deviance ratio through the iterations.
#| label: fig-EPXlikeC1
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

p1 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_EPX_C1$df_LnPost_start, 
  aes(
    x = iteration, 
    y = LnPosterior, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = c("1", "2", "3"), values = Nord_frost) +
  labs(
    x = "First half iterations", 
    y = "LnPosterior"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_EPX_C1$df_LnPost |> filter(iteration > 1), 
  aes(
    x = iteration, 
    y = LnPosterior, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = c("1", "2", "3"), values = Nord_frost) +
  labs(
    x = paste(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Nb_iter_kept, "last iterations"), 
    y = "LnPosterior"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_EPX_C1$df_Devc|> filter(iteration > 1), 
  aes(
    x = iteration, 
    y = RatioDeviance, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = c("1", "2", "3"), values = Nord_frost) +
  labs(
    x = paste(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Nb_iter_kept, "last iterations"), 
    y = "Ratio Deviance"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_LL <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_layout(ncol=3, guides = "collect")
p_LL

```

```{r saveEPXlikeC1, include = F}

  )

  filename="TK_EPX_likedevratio.svg", 
  plot=p_LL, 
  width=8, height = 4, 
  path=path_fig_C1
  )
```

```{r mcmclist, message=F, warning=F}
# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_C1 <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains, MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})
mcmc_list_C1 <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C1)

mcmc_list_C1P <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_EPX_C1P$Chains, MCMC_out_EPX_C1P$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})
mcmc_list_C1P <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C1P)

mcmc_list_C2 <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_EPX_C2$Chains, MCMC_out_EPX_C2$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})
mcmc_list_C2 <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C2)

mcmc_list_C2P <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_EPX_C2P$Chains, MCMC_out_EPX_C2P$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})
mcmc_list_C2P <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C2P)

```

## C1

```{r EPXpost, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors and the posteriors.
#| label: fig-EPXpostC1
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

alpha_prior <- 0.5
alpha_post <- 0.5
col_prior <- Nord_snow[1]
col_post <- col_EPX


MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains_plot <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) |> 
  filter(!((Nom %in% c("kcomp_in","kcomp_out") & value > 0.02)))|> 
  filter(!((Nom %in% c("kuEPX") & value > 5)))

p_post <- ggplot() +
  
  # Priors
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1,
    aes(
       x = samples,
       #y = ..scaled..
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy"
    ) +
  
  # Posterior
  stat_halfeye(
    data = subset(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains_plot, Nom %in% L_parameters_C1),
    mapping = aes(
      x=value
    ),
    fill = col_post,
    color = col_post,
    alpha = alpha_post,
    normalize = "xy"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  labs(
    title = "Posterior and prior distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    title=element_markdown(face="bold")
  )

p_post
```

```{r calcBCFEPX, message=F, warning=F}

f_get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

########## C1 #######################################################

MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$"))

ku_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "kuEPX")
ke_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_EPX_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "keEPX")

BCF_samples_C1 <- ku_samples_C1$value / ke_samples_C1$value

BCF_mode_C1 <- f_get_mode(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_CI_C1 <- quantile(BCF_samples_C1, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
BCF_CI_low_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[1])
BCF_CI_up_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[2])
BCF_min_C1 <- min(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_max_C1 <- max(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_mean_C1 <- mean(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_sd_C1 <- sd(BCF_samples_C1)

BCF_C1 <- c(
  BCF_mode_C1, 
  BCF_CI_low_C1, BCF_CI_up_C1, 
  BCF_min_C1, BCF_max_C1, 
  BCF_mean_C1, BCF_sd_C1
  )

########## C1P #######################################################
```

```{r bicC1}
# BIC calculation

LL_C1 <- f_get_mode(MCMC_out_EPX_C1$df_LnData$LnData)
n <- length(na.omit(df_TK_EPX$Weight)) + length(na.omit(df_TK_EPX$CiEPX))
k <- Nb_param_C1 -2

BIC_C1 <- -2*LL_C1 + k*log(n)

cat("Number of observations, n = ", n,"\nNumber of parameters, k = ", k, "\nLog-likelihood, LL = ", LL_C1, "\nBIC = ", BIC_C1)

```

```{r bicC2P}
# BIC calculation

LL_C2P <- f_get_mode(MCMC_out_EPX_C2P$df_LnData$LnData)
n <- length(na.omit(df_TK_EPX$Weight)) + length(na.omit(df_TK_EPX$CiEPX))
k <- Nb_param_C2P -2

BIC_C2P <- -2*LL_C2P + k*log(n)

cat("Number of observations, n = ", n,"\nNumber of parameters, k = ", k, "\nLog-likelihood, LL = ", LL_C2P, "\nBIC = ", BIC_C2P)

```

An example of how to run the simulations for the predicted-observed data is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, eval=F, execute=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_EPX
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 71); do
./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_Setpoint_ind_${j}.in
done
```

```{r EPXdatapred, message=F, warning=F}

Nb_experiment <- Nb_experiment_C1

######### Observed data ######################################################
dObs_ind <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(
    ID = as.numeric(ID),
    Group_tmp = case_when(
      ID < 65 ~ "Uptake",
      (ID > 64 & ID <= 128) ~ "Elimination",
      ID > 128 ~ "Uptake\n(with massage only)"),
    Group = fct_relevel(Group_tmp, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake\n(with massage only)"))
    )

colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiEPX"] <- "CiEPX_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"


############ C1 ##############################################################

Sim.Res.ind_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_EPX_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment_C1){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Time_pred = dObs_i$Time # !!!
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiEPX")
  
  Nsortie = 2
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight" & Time !=0)
df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiEPX" & Time !=0)

df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |> 
  left_join(df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred")) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(Weight_obs, CiIMD)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |> 
  left_join(df_mod_Weight_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred"))|>
  dplyr::select(-c(CiEPX_obs, CiIMD)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |>
```

```{r predobsEPXC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Results of the model fit on experimental data. Predicted values are represented with points with their respective credibility interval of 95%. Thin black and grey lines represent the 2-folds and 5-fold changes, respectively. The thicker black line represents the identity line. 
#| label: fig-EPXpredobsC1
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

fact_1 <- 2
fact_2 <- 5

col_line0 <- Nord_polar[1]
col_line1 <- Nord_polar[4]
col_line2 <- Nord_snow[1]

col_exposure_bis <- c(Nord_aurora[1], Nord_aurora[4], Nord_aurora[5])
shape_exposure_bis <- c(shape_IMD, shape_IMD, shape_EPX)
# "#BF616A" "#A3BE8C" "#B48EAD"

lim_min <-  min(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint, df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight)
lim_max <- max(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint, df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight)
seq_line <- seq(lim_min, lim_max, 0.001)

df_line <- data.frame(
  x1  = seq_line,
  y1  = seq_line*fact_1,
  x_1 = seq_line,
  y_1 = seq_line/fact_1,
  x2  = seq_line,
  y2  = seq_line*fact_2,
  x_2 = seq_line,
  y_2 = seq_line/fact_2
  )

p_W <- ggplot(
  data = df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1,
  mapping = aes(
      x = Weight_obs,
      y = predict.endpoint
    )
  )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x1, y=y1),
    color = col_line1
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x_1, y=y_1),
    color = col_line1
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x2, y=y2),
    color = col_line2
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x_2, y=y_2),
    color = col_line2
    )+
  
  geom_abline(
    slope=1, 
    intercept = 0, 
    color = col_line0,
    linewidth = 1
    )+
  geom_pointrange(
    mapping = aes(
      ymin = low,
      ymax = up
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = col_EPX
  )+
  xlim(
    xmin = min(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint)-0.05,
    xmax = max(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint)
  )+
  ylim(
    ymin = min(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint)-0.05,
    ymax = max(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$predict.endpoint)
  )+
  scale_x_log10(limits=c(lim_min, lim_max))+
  scale_y_log10(limits=c(lim_min, lim_max))+
  labs(
    x = "Observed weight of earthworms (g)",
    y = "Predicted weight of earthworms (g)"
  )+
  theme_minimal()

fact_1 <- 2
fact_2 <- 5

seq_line <- seq(0.5, 1500, 0.01)

df_line <- data.frame(
  x1  = seq_line,
  y1  = seq_line*fact_1,
  x_1 = seq_line,
  y_1 = seq_line/fact_1,
  x2  = seq_line,
  y2  = seq_line*fact_2,
  x_2 = seq_line,
  y_2 = seq_line/fact_2
  )

lim_plot <- 1000

p_CiEPX_predobs <- ggplot(
  data = df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1,
  mapping = aes(
      x = CiEPX_obs,
      y = predict.endpoint
    )
  )+
  geom_path(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x1, y=y1),
    color = col_line1
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x_1, y=y_1),
    color = col_line1
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x2, y=y2),
    color = col_line2
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_line,
    mapping=aes(x=x_2, y=y_2),
    color = col_line2
    )+
  geom_abline(
    slope=1, 
    intercept = 0, 
    color = col_line0,
    linewidth = 1
    )+
  geom_pointrange(
    mapping = aes(
      ymin = low,
      ymax = up,
      color = Group,
      shape = Group
    ),
    alpha = 0.5#,
    #color = col_EPX
  )+
  
  xlim(
    xmin = 0.5,
    xmax = max(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1$CiEPX_obs)
  )+
  ylim(
    ymin = 0.5,
    ymax = max(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1$predict.endpoint)
  )+
  labs(
    x = "Observed concentrations of EPX\nin earthworms (ng/g)",
    y = "Predicted concentrations of EPX\nin earthworms (ng/g)"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure_bis
    )+
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_exposure_bis)+
  scale_x_log10(
    limits=c(1, lim_plot)
    )+
  scale_y_log10(
    limits=c(1, lim_plot)
    )+
  theme_minimal()

p_predobs <- p_W + p_CiEPX_predobs
p_predobs
```

```{r countfoldEPXC1, warning=F}
df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 |>
  mutate(
    Ratio_predobs = predict.endpoint / Weight_obs,
    Residuals = predict.endpoint - Weight_obs
  )

Weight_count_fold2_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.5 & Ratio_predobs <= 2)$Weight_obs) / length(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight_obs) * 100

Weight_count_fold5_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.2 & Ratio_predobs <= 5)$Weight_obs) / length(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight_obs) * 100

df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1 |>
  mutate(
    Ratio_predobs = predict.endpoint / CiEPX_obs,
    Residuals = predict.endpoint - CiEPX_obs
  )

CiEPX_count_fold2_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.5 & Ratio_predobs <= 2)$CiEPX_obs) / length(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1$CiEPX_obs) * 100

  "For weights : \n\n",

)
cat(
  "\n\nFor internal concentrations : \n\n",
  "Percentage of prediction in fold 2 = ", round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C1, 1), "%\n",
```

```{r countfoldEPXC1P, warning=F}
)

CiEPX_count_fold2_C1P <- length(subset(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1P, Ratio_predobs >= 0.5 & Ratio_predobs <= 2)$CiEPX_obs) / length(df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1P$CiEPX_obs) * 100

cat(
  "For weights : \n\n",

)
cat(
  "\n\nFor internal concentrations : \n\n",

)
```

```{r, message=F, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: Residuals
#| label: fig-EPXresidualsC1
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

df_residuals_CiEPX_C1 <- df_predobs_CiEPX_ind_C1 |> 
  mutate(
    Residual = predict.endpoint - CiEPX_obs,
    Ratio_Residual = predict.endpoint/CiEPX_obs
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),
    Group = factor(Group, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake bis")),
    Time_relative = case_when(
      Group == "Uptake" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "TK_BIS" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "Elimination" ~ Time_point - 21
    )
    )

p_residus <- ggplot(df_residuals_CiEPX_C1)+
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = Time_point,
      y = Ratio_Residual,
      color = Group
    ),
    alpha=0.7
  )+
  labs(
    x = "Time point (days)",
    y = "Predicted/observed ratio"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure_bis
    )+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(df_residuals_CiEPX_C1$Time_point)
  )+
  scale_y_log10()+
  theme_minimal()
```

### Full individual trajectories

```{r setpointindfullin, message=F, warning=F}
Time_min <- 0
Time_max <- 44
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")
Molecule <- "EPX"

######### C1 ############################################################
l_param_name_C1 <- "kuEPX, keEPX, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_EPX_C1, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1)

######### C1P ############################################################
l_param_name_C1P <- "kuEPX, keEPX, phi, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_EPX_C1P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1P)

######### C2 ############################################################
l_param_name_C2 <- "kuEPX, keEPX, kperiph, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_EPX_C2, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2)

######### C2P ############################################################
l_param_name_C2P <- "kuEPX, keEPX, kperiph, phi, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_EPX_C2P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2P)

########## Observed data ##################

dObs_ind <- df_TK_EPX |> 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID))
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiEPX"] <- "CiEPX_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

time_limits <- dObs_ind %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(time_cutoff = max(Time, na.rm = TRUE) + 5)

Time_points_Nb_rep <- dObs_ind |> 
  dplyr::select(ID, Time_point_f, Nb_rep)

y_segment <- 1000

df_phases <- dObs_ind |>
  arrange(ID, Time) |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(ID, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & ID < 65) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID < 65) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & ID > 64) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID > 64) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & ID > 64) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  )

```

An example of how to run the simulations for the individual trajectories is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, results=F, eval=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_EPX
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 71); do
./mcsim.m_TK_EPX TK_EPX_Setpoint_ind_full_${j}.in
done

```

```{r EPXdatapredfull, message=F, warning=F}
##| cache: false

#nb_rows_ind_C1 <- NC_C1*N_iter_setpoint_C1+1

########## C1 #############################################

Sim.Res.ind.full_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment_C1, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_EPX_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_full_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment_C1){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind.full_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind.full_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiEPX", "C_exposure")
  
  Nsortie = length(Nom_Endpoints)
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind.full_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind.full_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_CiEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiEPX")
df_mod_CeEPX_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "C_exposure")
```

```{r EPXpredcurvesdataC1, message=F, warning=F}
    alpha = 0.7

  geom_line(

  geom_line(

      ),

    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C1,
```

```{r EPXpredcurvesdataC2, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Estimated toxicokinetic of the EPX concentration in earthworms exposed to 1000 ng/g of EPX. Red points represent the experimental data, the blue curve represent the estimated toxicokinetic curve and the transparent blue band correspond to the credibility interval of the model. 
#| label: fig-EPXdatapredfullC2
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 20

df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C2 <- subset(df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_C2, ID %in% ID_tri) |> 
  mutate(
    No_rep = paste0("No ", Nb_rep),
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),
    Time_point_days = paste0(Time_point_f, " days"),
    Time_point_days = fct_reorder(Time_point_days, as.numeric(Time_point))
  )

df_mod_CeEPX_ind_t_plot_C2 <- subset(df_mod_CeEPX_ind_t_C2, ID %in% ID_tri)

df_mod_Weight_ind_t_plot_C2 <- subset(df_mod_Weight_ind_t_C2, ID %in% ID_tri) |> 
  mutate(
    No_rep = paste0("No ", Nb_rep),
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),
    Time_point_days = paste0(Time_point_f, " days"),
    Time_point_days = fct_reorder(Time_point_days, as.numeric(Time_point))
  )

alpha_point <- 0.5
col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[2], Nord_aurora[3], Nord_aurora[4])

p_CiEPX_traj <- ggplot()+
  
  geom_segment(
    data = df_phases_plot,
    aes(
      x = t_start,
      xend = t_end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      group = ID,
      color = factor(Phase)
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C2,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_EPX
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C2,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= up,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_EPX
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C2,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= predict.endpoint,
      group = ID
      ),
    color = col_EPX,
    lwd=1
    )+
  geom_ribbon(
    data=df_mod_CiEPX_ind_t_plot_C2,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      ymax= up,
      ymin= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    fill = col_EPX,
    alpha=0.1
    )+
  geom_point(
    data = dObs_ind_plot,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = CiEPX_obs
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = col_red
  )+
  # facet_wrap(
  #   ~ID,
  #   ncol=4,
  #   #scales = "free_x"
  #   )+
  facet_grid(
    vars(Time_point_days), vars(No_rep)#,
    )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure,
    label = c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Depuration"),
    name = "Phase"
    )+
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "CiEPX (ng/g)"
  )+
  #lims(y=c(0, 300))+
  theme_minimal()
```

### Simulation of the toxicodynamic in earthworms throughout the exposition

The goal here is to recreate the concentration dynamic in the average earthworm during our exposition scheme but without the fasting phase that was required for chemical analysis and during which elimination was happening.

```{r setpointin, message=F, warning=F}

Time_min <- 0
Time_max <- 42
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")

######## C1 ###################################
l_param_name_tot_C1 <- "kuEPX, keEPX, a_growth, Vr_a_growth, Sigma_W, Sigma_CiEPX"
```

## Summary

In the case of epoxiconazole, the one-compartment model (C1) showed poor predictive performance with a clear underestimation of the steady-state and a poorly captured elimination dynamic (@fig-EPXpredobsC1). The two-compartment model (C2) slightly improved the fit but the most probable model is the two-compartment model with an exposure through the gut route in Petri dishes (C2P) which demonstrated excellent predictive performance for internal concentrations in individual earthworms, with individual trajectories closely matching observed data points (@fig-EPXdatapredfullC2P). All predictions fell within the 5-fold change region, with 91.5% within the 2-fold change region (@fig-EPXpredobsC2P). This improvement of model predictions is reflected in a much lower BIC (@tbl-EPXressumall). It should be noted, however, that the model still tends to overestimate internal concentrations during the second elimination phase (@fig-EPXresidualsC2P). The estimated toxicokinetic parameters of all tested models are summarized in @tbl-EPXressumall.

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
#| tbl-cap: "Estimated toxicokinetic parameters for single exposure of *Aporrectodea caliginosa* to epoxiconazole with the use of TK and TK BIS data. Results are expressed as the modes of the distributions and their respective credibility interval (95%). C1 : One compartment model, C1P : One compartment model with exposure through gut route in Petri dishes, C2 : Two-compartment model, C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure through gut route in Petri dishes, C2N : Two-compartment model with omission of the depuration phase in Petri dishes."
#| tbl-label: tbl-EPXressumall

format_summary <- function(summary_df, model_name) {
  
  summary_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(BCF = last_col()) |> 
    rownames_to_column("stat") %>%
    filter(stat %in% c("Result_mode", "2.5%", "97.5%")) %>%
    
    pivot_longer(-stat, names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
    
    mutate(
      value = sprintf("%.3g [%.3g ; %.3g]", Result_mode, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(model, param, value)
}

res_C1   <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C1, "C1")
res_C1P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C1P, "C1P")
res_C2   <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C2, "C2")
res_C2P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_EPX_f_C2P, "C2P")

all_res <- bind_rows(res_C1, res_C1P, 
                     res_C2, res_C2P)


round_fold <- 1

extra_metrics <- tibble(
  model = c("C1","C1P","C2","C2P"),
  LL   = c(round(LL_C1, round_fold), round(LL_C1P, round_fold), round(LL_C2, round_fold), round(LL_C2P, round_fold)),
  BIC  = c(round(BIC_C1, round_fold), round(BIC_C1P, round_fold), round(BIC_C2, round_fold), round(BIC_C2P, round_fold)),
  fold2 = c(round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C1, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C1P, round_fold),  
            round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C2, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold2_C2P, round_fold)),
  fold5 = c(round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C1, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C1P, round_fold), 
            round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C2, round_fold), round(CiEPX_count_fold5_C2P, round_fold))
)

final_table <- all_res %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = value) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("\\.1\\.$", "", .)) |> 
  relocate(BCF, .after = last_col()) |> 
  left_join(extra_metrics, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::select(model, everything())

final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = model
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -model
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

```

Model simulations of concentration dynamics in the average earthworm under the exposure scenario of the first toxicokinetic experiment (TK) (excluding the fasting phase used for chemical analysis during which elimination occurred) revealed distinct kinetic behaviors between the two pesticides (Figure 3). Epoxiconazole exhibited rapid uptake and elimination kinetics, while imidacloprid showed considerably slower uptake and elimination processes. Correspondingly, the bioaccumulation factor (BAF) was substantially higher for imidacloprid (21 gsoil·gworm, wwt-1) compared to epoxiconazole (0.87 gsoil·gworm, wwt-1), reflecting its greater tendency to accumulate in earthworm tissues and slower clearance from the organism.
